title: What's New: AL-Go for GitHub on Build and Performance (2025 release wave 1)

features.name: Incremental Builds
features.description: Only build apps that are actually modified in the commit, saving time on CI/CD and deployment. Previously only enabled for pull requests, now available for CI/CD builds with complete artifact sets.

features.name: Workflow Concurrency
features.description: Control workflow concurrency to cancel prior builds when multiple commits are made in quick succession, working together with incremental builds to save build time.

features.name: Conditional Settings Based Build Modes
features.description: Support conditional settings based on build modes, allowing different configurations like default and next major modes to specify different artifacts and behaviors.

features.name: Preprocessor Symbols in AL-Go
features.description: AL-Go now supports adding preprocessor symbols as settings, allowing developers to include different code paths during compilation based on specified symbols.

features.name: Short-Lived Artifacts
features.description: Full artifacts are now created in all builds as short-lived artifacts instead of artificial intermediate artifacts, with configurable retention periods replacing the previous one-day default.
caveats: Previously required artificial artifacts for multi-project builds

features.name: Versioning Strategy 3
features.description: New versioning strategy where major, minor, and build numbers are controlled by app.json, while only the fourth digit is controlled by GitHub counter.

features.name: Commit Options
features.description: Allow injecting messages into commit messages or pull requests, with options for message suffix, auto-merge, and pull request labels for integration with work item management tools.
